pitch.title: What I deliver
pitch.body: I work across the front end and back end in TypeScript, and I look after what happens after the deploy. Today I keep a high-traffic sports portal running in production. Before that, I led the migration of a legacy PHP system to Node and React. On the side, I run two products: BEKNO, which builds websites for small businesses, and VamosMarcar, a booking system for barbershops and salons.
